name: MacQueen
description: Search live hotel availability and prices worldwide. MacQueen checks real-time room inventory and returns only bookable deals — with total stay price, per-night rate, meal plan, cancellation policy, star rating, and guest review score. Ask follow-up questions about any hotel to get photos, amenities, exact location, and check-in policies. Fully bilingual in English and Arabic.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MacQueen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MacQueen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.macqueen.co/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is MacQueen MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, MacQueen scores 86/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MacQueen MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MacQueen provides these MCP tools: hotel_details and search_hotels.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MacQueen?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MacQueen in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
MacQueen does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
MacQueen is developed by MacQueen Tech. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
